 Defense 
 October 20, 2026 
 New base to ‘pilot’ energy independence push
 The Defense Department’s plans to construct a brand new U.S. base will be the “forerunner” of the Trump administration’s push to make every domestic military site energy independent, a leading Pentagon official said Tuesday.  
 Dale Marks, the assistant secretary of Defense for energy, installations and environment, said the Pentagon is already canvassing state officials and business leaders — governors, adjutants general and industry alike — for input on the future military installation, the first newly constructed base in the United States in decades.
